mapper.sql: w.id, w.order_no, w.title, w.type, w.priority, w.applicant_id, w.applicant_dept_id, w.approver_id, w.status, w.flow_id, w.current_node_order, w.round, w.create_time, w.update_time, u.name AS applicant_name, d.name AS dept_name, a.name AS approver_name, f.name AS flow_name, n.node_name AS current_node_name

FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN user u ON w.applicant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN dept d ON w.applicant_dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user a ON w.approver_id = a.id LEFT JOIN approval_flow f ON f.id = w.flow_id LEFT JOIN approval_flow_node n ON n.flow_id = w.flow_id AND n.node_order = w.current_node_order

sql.if: AND (w.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR w.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND w.status IN (1, 2) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM work_order_task t WHERE t.work_order_id = w.id AND t.approver_id = #{userId} AND t.round = w.round AND t.status = 0 )

mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, title, type, priority, content, applicant_id, applicant_dept_id, approver_id, status, flow_id, current_node_order, round, request_id, version, create_time, update_time FROM work_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT w.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM work_order w
GROUP BY w.status

SELECT w.type AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM work_order w
GROUP BY w.type

SELECT d.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN dept d ON w.applicant_dept_id = d.id
GROUP BY w.applicant_dept_id, d.name ORDER BY cnt DESC
